title: Delete logger_extra_test.dart — near-total weak-assertion duplicate of logger_extended_test.dart
why: logger_extra_test.dart's own header comment says it exists to cover 'methods not exercised' elsewhere, but every method it exercises (critical, debugMsg, warningMsg, errorMsg, criticalMsg, log, handle, talker getter) is already covered — with stronger content assertions via talker.history.last.generateTextMessage() — in logger_extended_test.dart, apparently added as a separate, later coverage pass unaware of the first. The file adds zero net coverage while doubling the maintenance surface: a signature change to any of these 8 AppLogger methods requires updating two files, and logger_extra_test.dart's `returnsNormally`-only assertions would stay green even if redacted/rendered message content silently regressed — only logger_extended_test.dart would catch that.
recommendation: Delete logger_extra_test.dart; if any exact call shape in it isn't covered by logger_extended_test.dart, fold that one case into the latter.
acceptance_criteria: logger_extra_test.dart is removed, or every test case in it asserts message content rather than just returnsNormally
Full test suite line count for test/core/logging drops with no coverage regression
